description: Sandboxed Code Interpreter: New jev/sandbox.py that extends the existing run_code() with Docker detection, matplotlib image capture (base64 PNG), and isolated execution. Add POST /v1/code/execute endpoint. Register code_execute as an agent tool. Add Code panel in Studio with textarea editor, Run button, stdout/stderr output, and inline image renders.
steps: Create jev/sandbox.py: function execute(source, language='python', capture_images=True, timeout_s=30). Check shutil.which('docker'). If Docker available: write source to tmpdir/main.py, prepend matplotlib Agg backend + savefig if 'plt' or 'matplotlib' in source, run: docker run --rm --network none --memory 256m --pids-limit 50 --cpus 0.5 -v {tmpdir}:/work python:3.11-slim python3 /work/main.py (subprocess, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout_s). If no Docker: use subprocess approach like existing tools.run_code() but with matplotlib capture. For image capture: if capture_images=True, prepend 'import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")' and append 'import os as _os, glob as _gl; [__import__("matplotlib").pyplot.savefig("/tmp/_urai_fig_{i}.png") for i,_ in enumerate(__import__("matplotlib").pyplot.get_fignums())]' to source. After run, glob /tmp/_urai_fig_*.png and base64-encode each. Returns {ok, stdout, stderr, exit_code, duration_s, images:[base64_str,...], language}. Handle ImportError for matplotlib gracefully.

Edit jev/tools.py: add function code_execute(source, language='python') that calls sandbox.execute(source, language). Import sandbox lazily inside the function. Register in TOOLS dict: TOOLS['code_execute'] = code_execute. Add schema to TOOL_SCHEMAS: {type:'function', function:{name:'code_execute', description:'Execute Python/JS/Bash code in an isolated sandbox and return stdout, stderr, and any matplotlib plots as base64 images', parameters:{type:'object', properties:{source:{type:'string'}, language:{type:'string', enum:['python','javascript','bash'], default:'python'}}, required:['source']}}}.

Edit jev/agent.py run_tool_call(): add dispatch case for 'code_execute': return tools.TOOLS['code_execute'](source=args.get('source',''), language=args.get('language','python')). Emit event via _events.emit() after execution.

Edit jev/server.py do_POST: add 'if p == "/v1/code/execute":' block. Parse body {source, language}. Validate source is non-empty string. Call sandbox.execute(source, language). Return result dict. Apply normal auth gate (already handled by gated path check). Emit event via events.emit('code_execute_api', 'code', 'server', 'code_execute', source[:100], str(result.get('exit_code'))). Add '/v1/code/execute' to the _guarded tuple (already covered by /v1/ prefix).
Edit jev/static/app.html: add 'Code' tab to sb-nav list (icon: 💻). Add panel div #panel-code. Panel contains: language selector
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "from jev.sandbox import execute; r=execute('print(6*7)'); assert r['stdout'].strip()=='42'; print('sandbox ok')"
curl -X POST http://localhost:8777/v1/code/execute -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"source":"print(99)"}' returns {ok:true, stdout:'99\n'}
Studio Code panel renders with textarea, Run button, and output area
